faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position, candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a university recognized by the Medical Council of India. Additionally, a minimum of two years of practical experience as a medical practitioner in a hospital or clinic is required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post in the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post will receive a salary of Rs. 1000 per hour.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the RBI BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment involves Document Verification and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post is Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 462016.

faq.answer: The official website of the Reserve Bank of India is https://www.rbi.org.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to download the application form.
